verdict.rationale: Runpod documents every part of the lifecycle across several surfaces. The REST API v1 covers all compute resources, and runpodctl handles `pod create` plus start/stop/terminate. Two official MCP servers manage Pods, endpoints, templates and volumes, and agent skills let a coding agent create Pods and deploy code. The GraphQL API can create, start, stop and query Pods, and SSH runs workloads on the Pod. Monitoring is the thinnest step: only Pod querying and CLI 'diagnose issues' are evidenced. missing for 10: documented GPU utilization metrics and log monitoring APIs, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent hands-on corroboration of a fully agent-driven provision-to-teardown run.
